assumptions: Only items #3 and #4 of the field's 2026-09-04 document are addressed to us
Both field stores are sqlite-era (records/ present); the chassis store's backend is unknown and asked
The read-audit release train W2→W5 remains the train of record; the A-batch send is still pending
The field runs the plugin; their launcher rung is unknown, so whether a server release reaches them automatically is unknown
constraints: Named design decisions (DD-6, DD-8, DD-11) are never patched inside waves
The owner-approved warn-and-fallback on old Node (01KWT0FEW6ETY4GD1G3C273Z3Y) forbids a fail-closed default
Git is the transport (01KWK9KTZGR2V148HJJ2CGY3ZY) — the server never commits; any committing path is a decision
Pre-tag adversarial review before every tag; every response field additive and optional-spread
context: Planned the response to field report 2026-09-04 items #3/#4 (cross-host sync, merge conflicts, old-Node ENOENT): docs/plans/2026-09-05-cross-host-sync-plan.md — DRAFT awaiting Dave's rulings; nothing implemented or sent
rationale: V6 EXECUTED: hook auto-staging is structurally impossible from a linked worktree (git add of the main-checkout path → exit 128 'outside repository'); server-side commits race the agent's index and double-commit with two servers; a committing CLI is unprecedented and needs credentials Twining does not hold — so the transport boundary is minted as DD-13 rather than built. Disclosure is also the precondition for the field to verify that drain-on-every-host closes the window.
summary: Chose disclosure-first for #3 (sync block on twining_status + one-line assemble caveat, local-only git state) over any mechanism that commits or stages records for the operator
